title: CropWatch Rwanda
subtitle: Amakuru y'ubuhinzi mu Rwanda, kuva 2018 kugeza 2026, amaze gukosorwa no guhuzwa.
trade_until: Idosiye y'ibicuruzwa byoherejwe hanze igera ku
home_lead: Uru rupapuro rwerekana amakuru yamaze gukosorwa. Umurongo umwe ni igihingwa kimwe ku murima wasuzumwe. Si umubare w'igihugu cyose.
not_all: Ikawa, icyayi, n'ibiribwa by'amatungo ntibiracyafite igiciro. Iminsi yo kwanika ntiracyanditse, bityo iyi porogaramu ntiraburira ku mvura yo mu gihe cyo kwanika. Imirongo y'ibicuruzwa byoherejwe hanze muri 2026 ntiri muri dosiye. Ubuzima bw'ibihingwa ni umubare umwe ku karere no ku mwaka.
safe_lead: Ibi ni ibihingwa bimwe mu bushakashatsi no ku rutonde rw'ibiciro. Ibishyimbo byo hasi n'ibishyimbo byo kuzamuka ni ibishyimbo byumye, bityo bisangira igiciro kimwe. Ariko ni ibihingwa bibiri. Ntukongere umusaruro wabyo ukawita igihingwa kimwe.
close_lead: Aya mazina arasa. Tuyabika ukwabyo kugira ngo ifu ititirwe umusaruro, kandi umuceri w'umutobo utitirwe umuceri uteka.
unmatched_lead: Ibi bihingwa by'ubushakashatsi nta giciro twizeye dufite. Benshi ni ibiribwa by'amatungo, ibinyampeke by'icyatsi, cyangwa ibindi.
season_lead: NISR ikoresha ibihembwe bitatu. Izi mezi ni izo mu gihugu cyose.
calendar_lead: Ku bigori no ku masaka, FAO yashyize hanze kalendari imwe y'igihugu muri 2015. Izi mezi zo gutera no gusarura zituruka kuri iyo kalendari. Iminsi yo kwanika ntabwo yashyizwe hanze, bityo umwanya w'iminsi yo kwanika urahari ubusa.
zone_lead: Iyi kalendari ya kabiri ituruka ku dosiye ya FAO mwongereyeho. Itanga igihe cyo gutera no gusarura ku bihingwa 12 mu duce 6 tw'ubuhinzi. Aka gace si akarere ka leta. Iminsi yo kwanika ntiracyariho.
rain_lead: Ibi bigereranya imvura y'ukwezi n'imvura isanzwe y'uko kwezi. Isanzwe ni impuzandengo ya 2018 kugeza 2025. Itandukaniro riri munsi ya zeru rivuga ko ukwezi kwari gukeye kurusha ukundi.
watch_lead: Umusaruro usanzwe ni uw'ahashize. Ibiciro bigereranywa mu gipimo kimwe. Ibicuruzwa ni ibigori HS 1005 kugeza 2025.
watch_drier: Imvura y'iki gihembwe iri munsi y'isanzwe ku kigero cya {pct:.0f}%. Umusaruro usanzwe w'ibigori hano ni {yield_kg:.0f} kg kuri hegitari. Ni impuzandengo y'ibihe byashize, si umusaruro w'iki gihembwe.
watch_wetter: Imvura y'iki gihembwe irenze isanzwe ku kigero cya {pct:.0f}%. Umusaruro usanzwe w'ibigori hano ni {yield_kg:.0f} kg kuri hegitari. Ni impuzandengo y'ibihe byashize, si umusaruro w'iki gihembwe.
watch_close: Imvura y'iki gihembwe iri hafi y'isanzwe ({pct:.0f}%). Umusaruro usanzwe w'ibigori hano ni {yield_kg:.0f} kg kuri hegitari. Ni impuzandengo y'ibihe byashize, si umusaruro w'iki gihembwe.
price_here: Igiciro cya nyuma cy'ibigori muri aka karere ni {price:.0f} FRW kuri kilo, ku wa {date}. Ni igiciro cy'isoko.
price_national: Aka karere nta giciro cy'ibigori gifite muri 2025 cyangwa 2026. Ku wa {date}, amasoko yavuze ibigori yagize impuzandengo ya {price:.0f} FRW kuri kilo.
veg_line: Mu mwaka wa {year} wose, umubare w'ibihingwa ku ifoto y'ikirere ni {now:.2f}. Isanzwe ya 2018–2025 ni {usual:.2f}. Uyu mubare ni uw'umwaka, si uw'igihembwe.
export_lead: Ibi ni ibicuruzwa by'ibigori byoherejwe hanze mu buryo bwemewe. Umubare wa World ntiwongewe ku bihugu. Nta dosiye ya 2026.
export_partners: Ibihugu bya mbere mu mwaka wa nyuma
how_1: Dosiye z'ubushakashatsi kuva 2018 kugeza 2025 zasomwe zikazana hamwe. Umurongo umwe ni igihingwa kimwe ku murima. Ntitwasibe imirongo itasanzwe. Ntitwahinduye ibipimo by'ubuso. Mu 2018 no mu 2019 ibipimo by'umurima ntibiri ku dosiye y'ibihingwa, bityo ayo myaka ntashobora guhindurwa umubare w'igihugu uvuye kuri iyo dosiye yonyine.
how_2: Idosiye y'ibiciro ni urutonde rw'amasoko rwa WFP. Itariki ya nyuma y'igiciro ni 15 Werurwe 2026. Dugereranya ibiciro gusa iyo igipimo ari kimwe.
how_3: Imvura ni iya buri kwezi, ku turere twose 30, kuva Mutarama 2018 kugeza Kanama 2026.
how_4: Amazina y'ibihingwa yahujwe dusoma urutonde rwombi. Ihuzwa rishyirwa ku rutonde rw'ibihuje neza gusa iyo ari igicuruzwa kimwe. Umutwe w'ubucuruzi ni umuryango mpuzamahanga w'igicuruzwa, si kode y'imibare itandatu ivuye mu idosiye nshya.
how_5: Ikinyarwanda muri iyi porogaramu ni izina risanzwe ry'igihingwa cyangwa iky'igihembwe. Amazina y'amakarere asigara uko ari, kuko ari amazina y'ahantu. Amazina y'intara akoresha Ikinyarwanda: Iburasirazuba, Iburengerazuba, Amajyaruguru, Amajyepfo, na Umujyi wa Kigali.
how_6: Iyi porogaramu ishobora gusomwa mu Kinyarwanda ku makuru yahuye. Ntiduhindura amahitamo ku bihingwa bidafite igiciro.
how_7: Urupapuro rw'ubutaka rukoresha igihembwe A cya 2022 gusa. Ni umwaka wa nyuma ibi bibazo byandikiwe mu magambo kandi ibipimo by'umurima biri ku dosiye. Umurima utagize ikibazo gikurikira, nyuma y'uko umuhinzi avuga ko icyo gikorwa kitakoreshejwe ku murima n'umwe, ubarwa nk'oya. Igihembwe B nticyongewe ku gihembwe A. Isuri iri hagati ni amazi anyura ku butaka. Isuri ikabije ni imyobo, inkangu, cyangwa ikuzimu. Isuri y'imvura igwa n'iy'umuyaga ntiziri muri iki gipimo.
soil_lead: Isuri, uburinzi, n'ifumbire by'igihembwe A cya 2022. Iyi mibare ivuga imirima yasuzumwe, si imirima yose.
soil_sentence: Mu gihembwe A cya 2022, {concern:.0f}% by'imirima yasuzumwe byari bifite isuri iri hagati cyangwa ikabije. {severe:.0f}% byari bikabije: imyobo, inkangu, cyangwa ikuzimu. {protected:.0f}% byari bifite uburyo bwo kurwanya isuri. {organic:.0f}% byakoresheje ifumbire kavukire. {inorganic:.0f}% byakoresheje ifumbire mvaruganda.
soil_short: Ku mirima yakoresheje ifumbire kavukire, {short:.0f}% bavuze ko ingano yari idahagije.
soil_rain_drier: Imvura y'igihembwe B cya 2026 hano iri munsi y'isanzwe ku kigero cya {pct:.0f}% ({rain:.0f} mm, igereranyije na {usual:.0f} mm). Umusaruro usanzwe w'ibigori ni {yield_kg:.0f} kg kuri hegitari. Iby'ubutaka ni ibya 2022. Imvura ni iya 2026.
soil_rain_wetter: Imvura y'igihembwe B cya 2026 hano irenze isanzwe ku kigero cya {pct:.0f}% ({rain:.0f} mm, igereranyije na {usual:.0f} mm). Umusaruro usanzwe w'ibigori ni {yield_kg:.0f} kg kuri hegitari. Iby'ubutaka ni ibya 2022. Imvura ni iya 2026.

hero_title: Reba uturere twatangiye iki gihembwe twumye kurusha isanzwe — kandi tutagira amazi yo kuhira.
hero_lead: CropWatch Rwanda ni icyicaro cy'igihembwe cy'ubuhinzi. Ihuza ubushakashatsi bw'imirima n'imvura n'iminsi irindwi iri imbere, hanyuma igaha intambwe usoma. Ntiyiteganya umusaruro w'iki gihembwe.

what_lead: Ikitubangamiye ni kuhira ku gipimo gito. Modeli y'umusaruro ishingiye ku mvura yarangijwe, ikatsindwa n'impuzandengo y'akarere, bityo ntiyashyizwe muri iyi porogaramu.
card_fresh_body: Imvura kuva 1 Nzeri 2026 ituruka kuri Open-Meteo. Isanzwe ya Nzeri–Ukwakira ni CHIRPS 2018–2025. Ni ibicuruzwa bibiri. Itandukaniro ni ikimenyetso, si milimetero zihuye neza.
card_rule_body: Iburira ryo kuhira rivuga ko imvura yageze aha iri munsi y'isanzwe ku kigero cya 10%, kandi imirima yasuzumwe yahijwe iri munsi ya 10% mu gihembwe A cya 2022.
card_action_body: Shyira imbere ibikombe byo kuhira, pompes n'ibishanga mu turere turi mu burira. Si igishushanyo cy'uruzi.
logic_1: Iburira ryo kuhira: imvura kuva 1 Nzeri iri munsi y'isanzwe ya Nzeri–Ukwakira ku kigero cya 10% cyangwa kurushaho, kandi imirima y'igihembwe A cya 2022 yahijwe iri munsi ya 10%.
logic_2: Uhire iki cyumweru: iryo burira, kandi iminsi irindwi iri imbere igera munsi ya 10 mm.
logic_3: Isuri n'imvura: byibuze 20% by'imirima byari bifite isuri iri hagati cyangwa ikabije, uburinzi buri munsi ya 80%, kandi imwe mu minsi irindwi igera kuri 15 mm cyangwa kurushaho.
logic_4: Umubare w'umusaruro ku karere ni impuzandengo y'ibigori yashize. Si umusaruro w'iki gihembwe.
alerts_title: Aho iki gihembwe gikeneye amazi cyangwa ubutaka
alerts_lead: Ibara ni iri burira. Kanda akarere ku ikarita, cyangwa uhitemo hepfo, urebe imvura igereranyije n'isanzwe, kuhira ku mirima yasuzumwe, n'iminsi irindwi.

week_lead: Imvura ya buri munsi ya Open-Meteo ku nkombe y'akarere. Ni iteganya ry'ikirere, si iry'umusaruro.
action_irrigation: Igikorwa: kuhira ku gipimo gito. Ibikombe, pompes, n'ibishanga. Si uruzi.
action_soil: Igikorwa: kurinda ubutaka. Imiyoboro, ibyatsi, n'amaterasi mbere y'imvura ikabije.
action_stable: Nta burira ryo kuhira muri aka karere uyu munsi. Komeza usome iteganya ry'iminsi irindwi.
how_8: Open-Meteo itanga imvura kuva 1 Nzeri 2026 n'iminsi irindwi iri imbere, ikoresheje hagati y'akarere ku ikarita ya NISR. Isanzwe ya Nzeri–Ukwakira ni CHIRPS 2018–2025. Ibipimo byo kuhira n'ubutaka ni imirima y'igihembwe A cya 2022, ifashijwe n'ibipimo. Modeli y'ibigori ishingiye ku mvura yarangijwe ikatsindwa n'impuzandengo y'akarere, bityo iyi porogaramu ishyira iri burira aho iryo teganya.
footer_blurb: Icyicaro cy'igihembwe cy'ubuhinzi bw'u Rwanda, avuye ku mirima ya NISR, CHIRPS, na Open-Meteo.
footer_copy: Hackathon ya NISR 2026 · Inzira 1 · Umusaruro w'ubuhinzi
sim_title: Niba kuhira cyangwa ifumbire byari bitandukanye mu 2022?
sim_lead: Ibipimo bikoresha itandukaniro ry'imirima ya 2022. Ni igerageza. Si ikigereranyo cy'ubufasha bwa MINAGRI, si umusaruro wa 2026.
sim_irrig_slider: Gerageza kwagura kuhira ku buso buciriritse (amanota y'ijana y'imirima)
sim_organic_slider: Gerageza kugabanya ibura ry'ifumbire kavukire (amanota y'ijana)
sim_irrig_help: Ongera igice cy'imirima yahijwe mu gihembwe A cya 2022. Umubare wa kg/ha ni itandukaniro mu karere muri 2022, si amafaranga y'ubufasha.
sim_organic_help: Gabanya igice cy'imirima yagize ifumbire kavukire nke. Umubare wa kg/ha ni itandukaniro mu karere muri 2022.
sim_protect_slider: Uburyo bwo kurwanya isuri (ntibukoreshwa nk'inyongera y'umusaruro)
sim_policy_note: NST2 na gahunda ya MINAGRI y'ubuhinzi bwo kuhira ku buso buciriritse (SSIT) zivuga kuhira n'ubutaka. MINAGRI yavuze ubufasha bwa 50% ku bikoresho byemewe. Iki kirahuri si amanota ya NST2, si ikigereranyo cy'ubufasha, kandi si umusaruro w'iki gihembwe.

Kongera kuhira {d_irrig:.0f} amanota no kugabanya ibura {d_short:.0f} amanota bihuye na {gain:.0f} kg/ha ({pct:+.1f}%).
sim_protect_note: Imirima ifite uburinzi bw'isuri yagize umusaruro muto mu karere kamwe mu 2022, birashoboka ko iri ku misozi. Uwo mubare ntitukawukoresha nk'inyongera.
benchmark_title: Igihembwe A cya 2022 — aho akabero k’igerageza gakomoka
benchmark_lead: Imirima 11,148, uturere 30. Imvura gusa itsindwa n’impuzandengo y’akarere. Ishyamba n’gradient boosting bitsinda iyo mpuzandengo. Imyaka indi iri mu mbonerahamwe zo hejuru. Si umusaruro wa 2026.
feat_title: Akamaro k’ishyamba ku mirima yose (si kimwe n’itandukaniro ry’igerageza)
map_lead: Shyira imbeba cyangwa ukande akarere urebe imvura igereranyije n'isanzwe, igice cy'imirima yahijwe mu gihembwe A cya 2022, n'imvura y'iminsi irindwi. Hitamo akarere mu rutonde rwo hepfo kugira ngo ufungure amakuru yako.
map_legend: Umutuku: uhire iki cyumweru · Icunga: icyuho cyo kuhira · Umuhondo: kuraba ubutaka · Icyatsi: nta burira
map_missing: Idosiye y'ikarita y'uturere ntiri ku disiki. Koresha python src/model_yield.py kugira ngo uyubake districts.geojson ku ikarita ya NISR.
how_9: Dosiye zose za SAS 2018–2026 z’ibigori A/B zasomwe. Modeli y’umurima isaba umusaruro, ibiro by’umurima, n’ihuza n’imikorere n’ifumbire. Ibyo biri muri 2022 A/B, 2023 A/B, na 2025 A. 2025 B irimo imirima mike. 2018–2019 nta plot_weight. 2024 nta buso. 2026 ni imbonerahamwe. 2020–2021 zifite umusaruro ariko ihuza rya kuhira riratsindwa; zikomeza muri panel y’uturere. CV yavuguruwe, CV y’uturere, n’isuzuma ryo gusiga umwaka byose byanditswe. Akabero gakoresha OLS ya 2022 A, si igenamiterere. s4q8 na s4q11 ni imashini, si ifumbire.
records_title: Imirongo y'ibihingwa mu bushakashatsi, ukurikije umwaka n'igihembwe
records_note: Iyi ni imirongo y'ibibazo, si toni z'igihugu cyose.
about_lead: Umushinga w'abanyeshuri wa hackathon ya NISR 2026, Inzira 1. Ni icyicaro cy'igihembwe, si igicuruzwa cya NISR cyangwa MINAGRI.
about_body: CropWatch igaragaza uturere 30 tw'u Rwanda twatangiye igihembwe A 2026 twumye kurusha isanzwe, kandi kuhira ku mirima yasuzumwe ari guke. Ikoresha dosiye za NISR, imvura isanzwe ya CHIRPS, Open-Meteo, na NASA POWER ku turere 4.
about_farmer: Umuhinzi: imvura y'iki cyumweru, SMS y'igerageza, n'inama mu magambo yoroshye.
about_agro: Umuhanga: ibyiciro by'ikarita, ubutaka, na NDRE.
about_policy: Ugena politiki: itandukaniro rya 2022 n'icyiciro cya SSIT. Nta giciro cyemewe kiri muri iyi dosiye.
about_ai: Inama zikoresha amakuru y'akarere. Niba urufunguzo rwa Groq cyangwa Gemini ruhari, Llama 3.1 cyangwa Gemini Flash yandika interuro. Niba rudahari, imibare ni yo iyo. Nta musaruro wihanganye.
chat_hello: Muraho. Nshobora gufasha kuri {district}. Imvura {rain:.0f}% ku isanzwe, iminsi 7 {week:.0f} mm. Imirima yahijwe {irrig:.1f}%. Baza imvura, ubutaka, igiciro, cyangwa icyiciro cyo kuhira.
chat_llm_on: Interuro ndende zikoresha Groq Llama 3.1. Imibare ikomoka ku dosiye z'aka karere.
chat_llm_off: Nta urufunguzo rwo hanze. Ibisubizo bikoma ku mbonerahamwe. Ongeraho GROQ_API_KEY muri .streamlit/secrets.toml.
role_all_lead: Ibikoresho byose biragaragara. Hitamo icyicaro kugira ngo intambwe ikurikira ibe iya mbere.
role_farmer_lead: Icyicaro cy'umuhinzi: imvura y'iki cyumweru, SMS y'igerageza ku telefoni ya kabiri, n'inama mu magambo yoroshye. Si ubutumwa bwa MINAGRI.
role_agronomist_lead: Icyicaro cy'umuhanga: hindura icyiciro cy'ikarita, soma isuri n'uhira, uigere NDRE n'umurongo w'igihugu.
role_policy_lead: Icyicaro cy'ubuyobozi: itandukaniro ry'imirima ya 2022, icyiciro cy'ibikoresho ku buso, n'ubufasha bwa 50% bwa SSIT. Nta giciro cyemewe kiri muri iyi dosiye.
layer_lead: Icyiciro kimwe gihuza amabara y'uturere 30. Imibare ni iy'imbonerahamwe.
filter_rain: Erekana uturere dukeye nk'aya cyangwa biruta (% ku isanzwe)
ndre_lead: Umubare umwe w'ibinyabuzima ku karere n'umwaka. Umurongo w'umweru ni impuzandengo y'uturere 30. Igihembwe A cya 2019 na 2023 cyari gukeye muri CHIRPS; NDRE nanone yagabanutse. 2026 ni yo ntoya muri iyi dosiye.

chat_price_note: Gereranya ibiciro mu gipimo kimwe. Ni igiciro cy'isoko, si icyemezo ku muhinzi.
chat_calendar: Ibihembwe bya NISR: A Nzeri–Gashyantare, B Werurwe–Kamena, C Nyakanga–Nzeri. FAO yashyize hanze mezi yo gutera ibigori n'amasaka; iminsi yo kwanika ntiyari muri iyo dosiye.
chat_yield: Umusaruro usanzwe w'ibigori muri {district} ni {yield_kg:.0f} kg/ha. Ni impuzandengo y'ejo, si umusaruro w'iki gihembwe. Imirima yahijwe muri 2022 yagize hafi 365 kg/ha kurushaho.
chat_veg: NDRE ya {district} mu 2026 ni {now:.3f}. Impuzandengo ya 2018–2025 ni {usual:.3f}. Umubare umwe ku mwaka.
chat_empty: Baza iby'imvura, kuhira, ubutaka, igiciro, cyangwa icyiciro cy'ibikoresho.
home_challenge_lead: Mu gihembwe A cya 2022, 2.2% gusa by'imirima ya NISR byahijwe. Iyo iki gihembwe A gitangira gukama kurusha isanzwe, iyo mirima nta cyo iyoboka. CropWatch ntiyihangira umubare munini kurusha uwo.
home_ch_1: Kwizera imvura, n'icyumweru gishobora gukina umurima.
home_ch_2: Isuri n'uburinzi budahagije ku mirima ya 2022.
home_ch_3: Uko igihembwe kimeze ntikimenyekana neza kugeza umusaruro ugeze — ntiyiteganya uwo musaruro.
home_ch_4: Amakuru y'ubushakashatsi, ibihe, satelite, n'isoko adahuza ubwabo.
home_ch_5: Imibare iguma ku mbonerahamwe keretse umuntu yagira intambwe: ibikombe, imirima y'amaterasi, cyangwa icyiciro cy'ibikoresho.
home_how_1: Imvura kuva 1 Nzeri 2026 igereranyije n'isanzwe ya Nzeri–Ukwakira (2018–2025). Ni ibicuruzwa bibiri, bityo itandukaniro ni ikimenyetso.
home_how_2: Igice cy'imirima ya 2022 yahijwe. Munsi ya 10% hamwe n'igihembwe cyumye ni iburira ryo kuhira.
home_how_3: Imvura y'iminsi 7 igereranyije n'amazi ibigori bikeneye. Niba n'icyumweru cyumye, iri burira rihinduka 'uhire uyu munsi'.
home_how_4: Itegeko ryanditse: imvura ≤ −10% kandi kuhira < 10% ni iburenganzira ryo kuhira. Isuri ikeneye isuri, uburinzi buke, n'umunsi wa 15 mm.
home_how_5: Amakarere, ikarita, kugereranya kwa 2022, icyiciro cya SSIT, n'inama. Si ifishi ya MINAGRI.
home_mod_alerts: Iburira — imvura igereranyije n'isanzwe, iminsi 7, n'ikarita.
home_mod_soil: Ubutaka — isuri, uburinzi, ifumbire y'igihembwe A 2022.
home_mod_season: Igihembwe — imvura, umusaruro usanzwe, igiciro, NDRE, n'ibicuruzwa.
home_mod_sim: Kugereranya — itandukaniro kg/ha rya 2022 n'icyiciro cya SSIT. Ni igerageza.
home_mod_advise: Inama — ikiganiro ku karere. Groq ni ihitamo.
home_nat_title: Uturere 30, itegeko rimwe, nta modeli ihishe.
home_nat_body: Ibipimo ku karere bifasha umugenzuzi kubona aho igihembwe A cyatangiye gukama n'aho kuhira ari guke. Ni ikimenyetso cy'amazi yoroheje, si urutonde rw'uturere twatsinzwe.
home_ev_title: Umubare w'ingenzi ufite dosiye, umwaka, n'imipaka.
home_ev_body: Inkomoko y'Amakuru igaragaza abafatanyabikorwa n'amasoko y'imibare yizewe. Uburyo bugaragaza uko imibare yakusanyijwe n'icyitegererezo cy'ubwenge bw'ubukorano. Abo turi bo bisobanura intego z'ubufatanye na gahunda za NST2 na PSTA 5.
home_nst_title: NST2 na Vision 2050 nk'imiterere ya politiki, si amanota yemewe.
home_nst_body: Inzira 1 isaba umusaruro, amazi, n'ubutaka. CropWatch ihuza kuhira n'isuri hakoreshejwe imirima ya NISR. SSIT ni gahunda ya 50% ku bikoresho byemewe. Iyi porogaramu ntiyishyira iyo nkunga.
home_final_body: Ntugomba kumenya dosiye. Hitamo akarere uzi, soma iri burira, hanyuma soma impamvu.
dash_lead: Imibare y'igihugu hejuru. Hanyuma uhitemo akarere urebe iri burira, impamvu, n'imvura y'iki cyumweru. Umusaruro usanzwe ni uw'ahashize, si uyu mwaka.
dash_profile_lead: Isuri n'ukuhira ni ibya 2022. Imvura n'icyumweru ni 2026. Si umwaka umwe.
export_note: CSV na HTML birimo inkomoko n'itegeko. Si icyemezo cya Leta.
why_irrigation_gap: Iburenganzira ryo kuhira: imvura kuva 1 Nzeri 2026 iri munsi y'isanzwe ya Nzeri–Ukwakira ku kigero cya 10% (CHIRPS 2018–2025), kandi imirima yahijwe iri munsi ya 10% (SAS A 2022).
why_irrigate_now: Uhire iki cyumweru: iryo tegeko, kandi iminsi 7 igera munsi ya 10 mm.
why_soil_rain: Ubutaka n'imvura: byibuze 20% bifite isuri, uburinzi munsi ya 80%, n'umunsi wa 15 mm mu minsi 7.
why_soil_watch: Kuraba ubutaka: isuri n'uburinzi birengeje, ariko icyumweru si cyo gikabije.
why_dry_watch: Gutangira gukama: imvura iri inyuma, ariko kuhira ntabwo ari ho hahagaze.
why_stable: Nta burira ku itegeko ryanditse. Kuhira gushobora kuba guke. Soma iminsi 7.
why_sources: Inkomoko: NISR SAS A 2022; CHIRPS 2018–2025; Open-Meteo kuva 1 Nzeri 2026. CHIRPS na Open-Meteo ni ibicuruzwa bibiri.
src_lead: Buri nkomeko ifite uwavitse, igihe, n'imipaka. Nta na kimwe ari isura y'umurima.
method_lead: Uko imirima yazanwe, uko iri burira ryanditswe, n'uko modeli y'ibigori yagereranyijwe hanze. Modeli si umusaruro w'iki gihembwe.
gl_forecast: Agricultural forecast — igenamiterere (iyi porogaramu nta musaruro iteganya)
about_obj_body: Guhishura uturere twatangiye gukama kandi kuhira ari guke. Kwerekana isuri ya 2022. Kuvuga umusaruro ukuri: isanzwe n'itandukaniro rya 2022, si umusaruro wa 2026.
footer_disclaimer: Iburira n'imodeli ni ubufasha mu byemezo. Si ingaruka zizewe ku murima, si igicuruzwa cya NISR, MINAGRI, cyangwa NST2.
footer_privacy: Nta kwinjira bisabwa. Urufunguzo rwa Groq ruguma ku seriveri.
footer_limitations: Imipaka: SAS 2026 ni imbonerahamwe; ibiciro bya WFP ni bike; nta Comtrade 2026; iminsi yo kwanika ntiyashyizwe hanze; CHIRPS ≠ Open-Meteo.
footer_ack: Amakuru: NISR SAS n'ikarita; CHIRPS; Open-Meteo; NDRE; WFP; Comtrade; FAO. NASA POWER ikoreshwa ku turere 4 gusa.
sim_assump: Iki gigeragezo ni igerageza. Gikoresha itandukaniro rya 2022. Si politiki yemejwe.
alerts_explain: Itandukaniro ry'imvura ni imvura y'iki gihembwe A igereranyije n'isanzwe ya Nzeri–Ukwakira (CHIRPS 2018–2025). Iminsi 7 n'ET0 ni Open-Meteo. Kuhira n'isuri ni SAS A 2022. ETc ikoresha Kc ya FAO-56, si isura y'umurima.
soil_explain: Isuri n'uburinzi bivuye ku bibazo bya 2022. Ifumbire ni dosiye s3q*, si imashini s4q8/s4q11.
watch_explain: Imvura, umusaruro usanzwe, NDRE, n'igiciro biruzuzanya. Si umubare umwe w'umusaruro.
empty_district: Nta murongo. Fungura akabero k'imvura cyangwa hitamo uturere twose.
cover_title: Imyaka ya SAS yinjiye muri modeli y’ibigori
cover_lead: Buri dosiye yasomwe. Umusaruro ku ha usaba umusaruro n’ubuso (cyangwa yield yanditse), plot_weight, n’ihuza n’imikorere n’ifumbire. Imyaka idashobora iyo nzira yanditswe hano, ntihishwe.
slice_lead: Buri murongo ni igerageza rya 3-fold kuri iyo gihembwe. Imvura, impuzandengo y’akarere, n’ishyamba ry’imikorere + imvura + NDRE. Niba ishyamba ritsinda akarere, imikorere iragira akamaro gato. Si umusaruro wa 2026.
pooled_lead: Imirima 28,042. 5-fold ishobora gukwirakwiza akarere. CV y’uturere isiga akarere kose — ni igerageza rikomeye ko imikorere ijya ahandi.
panel_lead: Igihe ihuza ry’umurima ridakora, impuzandengo z’uturere ziriho muri 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023 na 2025. Gusiga umwaka ugerageza niba imvura na NDRE biteganya umwaka model ntiyigeze ibona. R² mbi bisobanura ko bitabikora.
sim_source_note: Akabero k’igerageza gakomeza gukoresha OLS y’igihembwe A cya 2022. Uwo mwaka ufite yield yanditse, imirima 11,148, n’uturere 30. Imyaka indi yagereranyijwe hejuru kugira ngo itandukaniro rya 2022 ritabona nk’icyo gusa. Nta musaruro w’iki gihembwe.
climate_lead: Ibi byiciro bikoresha ET0 ya Open-Meteo, Kc y'ibigori ya FAO-56, n'itandukaniro ry'imvura. Si umusaruro, si NASA SMAP.
intel_used_body: NISR SAS A 2022; CHIRPS 2018–2025; Open-Meteo n'ET0 kuva 1 Nzeri 2026; iminsi 7. NDRE ni umubare w'umwaka, si iki cyumweru.
intel_method_body: Iburenganzira ryo kuhira niba imvura iri munsi ya 10% kandi kuhira ari munsi ya 10%. Isuri n'imvura niba isuri ≥20%, uburinzi <80%, n'umunsi wa 15 mm. FAO-56: ETc = ET0 × Kc. Imvura y'akamaro 60%/80%. Ibarura = Pe − ETc.
intel_limits_body: Kc ikoresha itariki yo gutera 15 Nzeri 2026, si isura y'umurima. Amazi yabitswe ntabwo tuzi. NASA POWER na SMAP ntibihujwe. Si itegeko rya MINAGRI.
intel_balance: Iki cyumweru: imvura y'akamaro {pe:.0f} mm ikuramo ETc {etc:.0f} mm = {bal:+.0f} mm (Kc {kc:.2f}, {stage}). Si ubushyuhe bw'ubutaka.
home_mod_water: ETc y'ibigori FAO-56: ET0 ya Open-Meteo × Kc, igereranyijwe n'imvura y'icyumweru. Si seniteri y'ubutaka.
how_10: Amazi y'ibigori FAO-56: ET0 ya Open-Meteo, Kc 0.30/1.20/0.60, iminsi 20/35/40/30. Itariki yo gutera 15 Nzeri 2026. Imvura y'akamaro 60%/80%. NASA POWER na SMAP ntibihujwe. Si umusaruro, si isuri, si ubushyuhe bw'umurima.
pilot_note: Uturere tw'igerageza mu nyandiko: Bugesera, Nyagatare, Musanze, Nyaruguru. Iyi porogaramu ikubiyemo uturere 30.
gl_etc: Crop evapotranspiration (ETc) — amazi igihingwa gikoresha (ET0 × Kc)
pilot_lead: Bugesera, Nyagatare, Musanze na Nyaruguru. Itegeko rimwe n'utundi 26, hamwe n'ubushyuhe na NASA POWER.
pilot_body: Iyi ni porogaramu-gerageza. Uturere 30 biguma kuri Incamake n'Iburira. SMAP ntihujwe. Imvura ya POWER ntiyongerwa kuri CHIRPS.
pilot_limits: NASA POWER ni ikirere ku nkomoko y'akarere, 1 Nzeri–29 Ukwakira 2026. Si seniteri, si ubushyuhe bw'ubutaka. Itariki yo gutera ni 15 Nzeri 2026.

guide_alerts_map_title: Uburyo bwo Gusoma Ikarita y Igihugu
guide_alerts_map_desc: Iyi karita igaragaza uturere 30 tw u Rwanda dushyizwe mu byiciro hisunzwe amakuru y iteganyagihe n amazi. Umutuku werekana Icyuho cy Amazi cyihutirwa (imvura nkeya n ubuso butuhirwa), Umondo ukerekana Kwitonda (imvura yabaye nkeya mu buryo buciriritse), naho Icyatsi kikerekana Ubuhehere buhagije. Hitamo ibyiciro by ikarita (Integuza, Ibyiciro by Ikirere, Imvura yabaye nkeya, Kuhira, Isuri, cyangwa Ubwatsi NDRE) kugira ngo urebe aho ibibazo biherereye.
guide_alerts_table_title: Imbonerahamwe yo Guteganya Ibyihutirwa mu Turere
guide_alerts_table_desc: Uturere dutondekwa hisunzwe uko imvura yabaye nkeya ugereranyije n ikigereranyo cyo kuva mu 1981 kugeza 2025. Aho iteganyagihe ry iminsi 7 ryerekana ko amazi ari munsi ya zeru (< 0 mm), abashinzwe ubuhinzi mu karere n abashinzwe kuhira bagomba guhita bategura imashini zo kuhira zikura amazi mu bishanga, mu migezi, cyangwa mu bidendezi bifata amazi.
guide_dashboard_matrix_title: Imbonerahamwe y Ubushakashatsi bw Ubuhinzi mu Gihugu
guide_dashboard_matrix_desc: Amakuru ari kuri iyi mbonerahamwe akomoka ku bushakashatsi bw ubuhinzi bw Ikigo cy Igihugu cy Imibare (NISR SAS) mu bihembwe A, B, na C. Ahuza umusaruro, ubuso bwejejweho, umusaruro kuri hegitari, n ikoreshwa ry ifumbire mvaruganda, imborera, n imbuto zatoranyijwe kugira ngo bifashe gupima uko ubuhinzi bw igihugu buhagaze.
guide_pilot_telemetry_title: Iteganyagihe ry Icyogajuru cya NASA mu Turere tw Icyitegererezo
guide_pilot_telemetry_desc: Icyogajuru cya NASA POWER gitanga amakuru ya buri munsi ku mirasire y izuba (MJ/m2/umunsi), ubushyuhe bw umwuka (°C), n ubuhehere. Ihuga ry amazi (ET0) ribarwa hisunzwe amategeko ya FAO-56 Penman-Monteith. Itandukaniro ry amazi mu muzi w igihingwa (Imvura yakiriwe uvanyemo amazi yahwitswe) ryerekana neza niba ubutaka bufite amazi ahagije cyangwa niba bukeneye kuhirwa bidatinze.
guide_soil_terraces_title: Gahunda yo Kubungabunga Ubutaka n Amaterasi y Indinganire
guide_soil_terraces_desc: Hafi 75% by ubutaka bwo guhinga mu Rwanda buri ku misozi ihanamye irengeje impinga ya dogere 16. Mu rwego rwo gushyira mu bikorwa intego za NST2, imisozi iri hejuru ya dogere 16 ifite ubutaka burengeje santimetero 50 igomba gushyirwaho amaterasi y indinganire, amaterasi yikora, n ibiti bivangwa n imyaka (nka Kalyandara na Alinusi) kugira ngo ubutaka bwera butagenda n isuri.
guide_watch_phenology_title: Amateka y Ibihembwe n Isano n Ibiciro by Amasoko
guide_watch_phenology_desc: Iyi mbaturabumenyi ihuza ibintu bitatu by ingenzi: ihindagurika ry imvura ugereranyije n imyaka 8 ishize, uburumbuke bw ibihingwa k uburezi bwa Sentinel-2 NDRE, n ibiciro by ibiribwa ku masoko y icyaro bya WFP VAM. Ibi bituma hamenyekana niba amapfa yateye igabanuka ry umusaruro ahita atera izamuka ry ibiciro mu masoko y akarere.
guide_sim_model_title: Igereranya ry Umusaruro rishingiye ku Bwenge bw Ubukorano
guide_sim_model_desc: Bitandukanye n imibare y ikigereranyo gusa, iyi sisitemu ikoresha imibare y imirima irenga 28,000 yakusanyijwe na NISR. Mu gihe ikirere kigumye uko cyari kiri, umuhinzi cyangwa umukozi w ubuhinzi ashobora kureba uko umusaruro wiyongera mu gihe hongerewe kuhira, imbuto zatoranyijwe, cyangwa ifumbire mvaruganda.
guide_sim_ssit_title: Gahunda ya MINAGRI na RAB yo Kuhira ku Buso Buto (SSIT)
guide_sim_ssit_desc: Muri Minisiteri y Ubuhinzi n Ubworozi (MINAGRI) n Ikigo cy Ubuhinzi n Ubworozi (RAB), Leta y u Rwanda itanga inkunga ya 50% ku bikoresho byo kuhira ku buso butarengeje hegitari 10. Iyi mbonekarita igufasha kubara agaciro k ibikoresho bikenewe (moteri zikoresha mazutu cyangwa izuba, imiyoboro, n ibitonyanga) no kureba igihe bizasubiriza igishoro.
guide_advise_copilot_title: Umujyanama mu By ubuhinzi ukoresha Ubwenge bw Ubukorano
guide_advise_copilot_desc: Uyu mujyanama afite amakuru yimbitse ku turere twose tw u Rwanda n ubwoko bw ubutaka. Afasha abashinzwe ubuhinzi mu mirenge, abayobozi ba koperative, n abahinzi kumenya indwara z ibihingwa, igipimo cy ifumbire gikwiye, igihe cyo kuhira, no kwirinda ingaruka z amapfa. Baza ibibazo mu Kinyarwanda cyangwa mu Cyongereza.
guide_advise_ussd_title: Uburyo bwo Kohereza Ubutumwa Bugufi kuri Telefoni zisanzwe
guide_advise_ussd_desc: Kugira ngo amakuru agere ku muhinzi wo mu cyaro udafite telefoni igezweho cyangwa interineti, inama zose zishyirwa mu magambo magufi atarengeje inyuguti 160 akwiranye na gahunda ya USSD cyangwa SMS zishobora koherezwa ku mirongo ya MTN na Airtel mu Rwanda.

home_who_agro: Umuhanga mu buhinzi ashobora gufungura ikarita, ubutaka, n'impamvu y'iburira.
home_who_plan: Ugenzura ashobora kubona aho kuhira ari guke n'aho igihembwe cyatangiye gukama — ni ikimenyetso, si urutonde rw'ubuntsinzi.
home_start_body: Iburira rigaragaza uturere 30. Akarere kereka ahantu hamwe. Inama zisubiza mu Cyongereza cyangwa Ikinyarwanda uhereye ku mbonerahamwe iyo.
